text:
## Audit & Monitoring  
**Internal Audit:**
- Annual fraud control testing
- File sampling (fraud investigations)
- Reimbursement accuracy and timeliness
- Evidence documentation  
**Regulatory Audit:**
- FCA periodic fraud prevention reviews
- Compliance with payment services regulations

raw_entities.name: Fraud Prevention Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing fraud prevention, detection, investigation, and customer reimbursement processes. The policy is subject to FCA periodic reviews and compliance with payment services regulations, and includes internal audit testing of fraud controls and reimbursement accuracy.

raw_entities.name: Annual Fraud Control Testing
raw_entities.description: A mandatory annual internal audit requirement to test the effectiveness and operation of fraud control measures implemented across the bank.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation File Sampling
raw_entities.description: An internal audit requirement to sample and review fraud investigation files to ensure proper investigation procedures and documentation standards are maintained.

raw_entities.name: Reimbursement Accuracy and Timeliness Review
raw_entities.description: An internal audit obligation to verify that customer reimbursements for fraud losses are processed accurately and within required timeframes.

raw_entities.name: Evidence Documentation Audit
raw_entities.description: An internal audit requirement to verify that fraud investigation evidence is properly documented and retained in accordance with policy standards.

raw_entities.name: FCA Periodic Fraud Prevention Review Compliance
raw_entities.description: A requirement to comply with FCA periodic fraud prevention reviews and demonstrate ongoing adherence to fraud prevention standards.

raw_entities.name: Payment Services Regulations Compliance
raw_entities.description: A requirement to maintain compliance with payment services regulations as part of regulatory audit obligations.

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority
raw_entities.description: The UK financial regulator responsible for conducting periodic fraud prevention reviews and overseeing compliance with payment services regulations.

raw_entities.name: Payment Services Regulations
raw_entities.description: Regulatory framework governing payment services that the bank must comply with, including fraud prevention and customer protection obligations.

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: The risk of fraudulent transactions, account takeover, or unauthorized use of customer accounts and payment instruments. The policy addresses fraud detection, investigation, and customer reimbursement.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Control Testing
raw_entities.description: An annual internal audit control measure to test the effectiveness of fraud prevention and detection systems across the organization.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation File Review
raw_entities.description: An internal audit control mechanism involving sampling and review of fraud investigation files to ensure compliance with investigation standards and documentation requirements.

raw_entities.name: Reimbursement Accuracy Verification
raw_entities.description: A control measure to verify the accuracy and timeliness of customer reimbursements for fraud losses through internal audit procedures.

raw_entities.name: Internal Audit Function
raw_entities.description: The internal audit function responsible for conducting annual fraud control testing, sampling fraud investigation files, verifying reimbursement accuracy and timeliness, and reviewing evidence documentation.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Audit Function
raw_entities.description: The regulatory audit function responsible for conducting FCA periodic fraud prevention reviews and ensuring compliance with payment services regulations.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: The process of investigating suspected fraud incidents, including file documentation and evidence collection, subject to internal audit sampling and review.

raw_entities.name: Customer Reimbursement
raw_entities.description: The process of reimbursing customers for fraud losses, subject to audit verification for accuracy and timeliness of payment.
